note: Archetype-spread query set for the market screen. Keep the two control queries: they are calibrated against manual readings in scripts/validate-play-scan.mjs, so a change in their verdict means the sensor drifted, not that the market moved.
steeringWarning: This file is a SENSOR INPUT, not a build direction. It exists so the relevance guard stays calibrated against manual readings. A query appearing here is not a recommendation to build that app, and a `candidate` verdict for a query here is not evidence that the app is worth building. In particular the `trade-calculators` group is a calibration group: the factory's first real slot was scaffolded out of it and failed commercially (see docs/reviews/2026-09-26-slot-1-economics-postmortem.md). Calculators, converters and generic arithmetic tools are a closed topic per .cursor/rules/ideation-gate.mdc. Every idea chosen for a slot must come from docs/ideation/ and must pass scripts/check-economics.mjs.

archetypes.label: Trade and professional calculators
archetypes.steering: CALIBRATION GROUP ONLY - not a build direction. Kept because the measured electrician field is a known-good shelf the relevance guard should still classify correctly. Do not choose a slot from this group; see the steeringWarning above.
archetypes.why: The measured electrician field has a 5M+ install leader selling ads + IAP, with weak mid-tier competitors. That is a fact about that one shelf, recorded so the sensor can be checked - it is not a template the factory should copy. The factory shipped a calculator out of this group and it failed commercially, which is why calculators are now a closed topic.

archetypes.label: Hobby and enthusiast tools
archetypes.why: Passionate users with repeat use and disposable income, and jobs that incumbents often serve badly.

archetypes.label: Narrow-angle health and care tracking
archetypes.why: The measured assistive field (visual schedule autism) had the weakest incumbents seen: many rated apps, most of them poor.

archetypes.label: AI-capability tools (DeepSeek as engine)
archetypes.why: The factory holds a DeepSeek key, so a slot can sell consumable inference credit (SERVER_COST fulfilment). Only viable where AI does a tedious niche job, never as a chat window — see AGENTS.md 'Defaults to suppress'.

archetypes.label: Calibration controls
archetypes.why: Known verdicts from manual reading. Used to detect sensor drift, not as candidates.
